explanation: The explicit form of Serre's uniformity conjecture over ℚ: surjectivity for all non-CM E/ℚ and all primes p > 37 (37 is sharp because of the rational 37-isogenies; Lemos arXiv:1702.01985 proves exactly this bound for the curves with a rational cyclic isogeny). Same faithful encoding as serre_uniformity with C = 37. Faithful.
